text:
taylor_pm: proposing an SLA-aware, tenant-prioritized rollout for the new quant-defaults + routing policy. aim: aggressive cost wins while keeping top customers locked to SLA. want feedback on ramp policy and rollback automation.

taylor_pm: TL;DR plan: (A) seed with shadow traffic (0%) + telemetry, (B) deterministic tenant canaries (select top-10 tenants by traffic + 5 random small tenants) at 0.05% global, (C) expand by weighted slices honoring SLA tiers (gold/silver/bronze) up to 20% then global. auto-rollback triggers + manual gates described below.

sam_sre: like the deterministic canary idea. we need clear roll-forward criteria and an emergency isolation strategy per-tenant/region. propose per-tenant circuit-breaker `cb:tenant:{id}` that flips to previous model variant.

lee_research: for quality gating: we'll run ensemble eval + session-coherence metric. new metric: session-coherence-drop >= 0.12 triggers hold. will publish baseline distributions by tenant tier.

taylor_pm: suggested telemetry pass/fail: latency p95 delta < 25ms, error-rate uplift < 0.15pp, session-coherence-drop < 0.12, and cost-per-token improvement > 5% (so there's a benefit).

diego_eng: implementation constraints: we need rollout metadata: `rollout_id`, `slice_id`, `tenant_ids[]`, `start_ts`, `expires_at`, `stage` with values [shadow, tenant-canary, tier-slice, broad, global]. store in rollout service and expose API. also adding `force_exempt` label for dedicated/contracted tenants.

anya_cs: must include a customer-visible toggle in the tenant admin panel and a one-click opt-out from the CS console. for enterprise we need to log opt-out reason and attach to billing note.

olivia_sales: FYI: AEs want advance notice before any tier-slice that includes their accounts. Suggest we send templated heads-up email when stage moves to tier-slice for any impacted account.

sam_sre: failure modes: (1) region-local p95 spike, (2) tenant-specific quality complaints, (3) backpressure on KV cache. recovery actions: (a) regional reroute to prior model binary, (b) tenant-level rollback, (c) enable conservative batching. need playbook entries for each.

taylor_pm: agree. adding per-region fast-fail flag `region_kill:{region_code}` and per-az fallback mapping. also add a runbook pointer: /runbooks/rollouts/tenant-isolation.md

lee_research: about canary selection: first round picks high-variance tenants plus at least two EU and two APAC tenants to validate geo behaviors. later rounds sample proportionally to traffic with min-tenant-count to avoid single-tenant noise.

diego_eng: telemetry channels to publish: `telemetry.rollout.{id}.metrics` (kafka), and a dashboard `rollout-{id}-live` in the console with per-tenant tiles. I'll add cost delta and token-rate sparkline.

ci-bot: Created ticket ROLL-4123 and pipeline run r-2024-11-08-09.

anya_cs: escalation policy: if any enterprise tenant sees >5% quality drop or >50ms p95 increase, CS paged and immediate opt-out recommendation. we need automatic alert links to the tenant opt-out toggle.

sam_sre: propose RBAC for manual rollouts: only SRE+PM+Eng leads can jump to `broad` or `global` without a mandatory wait. auto-rollforward allowed only up to `tier-slice` if metrics are green for 45 minutes.

taylor_pm: concrete ramp schedule draft: shadow 24h for data, tenant-canary 1h hold, tier-slice step 45m hold per step, broad 2h hold, then global. manual approvals required between broad->global.

lee_research: we'll supply weekly stale-detection for rollout flags. also add `canary_sample_seed` so the deterministic tenants are reproducible.

diego_eng: flag examples: `quant_v3_stage`, `quant_v3_exempt_tenants`, `quant_v3_rollout_id`. will add short docs in /docs/flags.md and include schema in PR.

olivia_sales: request: include a one-liner in the customer communication about data privacy & KMS — enterprise customers will ask.

anya_cs: noted. also recommend a pre-roll internal customer advisory pack for AEs and CSMs with anticipated timelines and rollback SLAs.

sam_sre: testing checklist for staging: synthetic p95 spike test, cache-thrashing test, and tenant-isolation test. will add automated chaos test that flips `region_kill` mid-run.

taylor_pm: next steps: diego to PR rollout schema by Tue, sam to author staging chaos tests by Wed, lee to publish eval baselines by Wed EOD, anya to draft customer advisory template. we'll reconvene Friday sprint sync. :thumbsup:

diego_eng: ack, starting PR. will include sample curl snippets for the rollout API, e.g.:
```
curl -XPOST https://rollouts.internal/api/v1/start -d '{"rollout_id":"r-4123","stage":"tenant-canary","tenant_ids":["t-1001","t-2100"]}'
```

lee_research: quick Q: how long should we consider a tenant "canary" after initial exposure? recommend 48h of focused sampling for those tenants.

anya_cs: 48h seems fine. we should flag any feedback within the first 6h as high-priority.

olivia_sales: I'll coordinate AE notifications. pls ping when we hit tier-slice.

taylor_pm: thanks all. tagging: @sam_sre @diego_eng @lee_research @anya_cs @olivia_sales. aiming to start shadowing next Monday.
